recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-30705 unless future link checking shows the dicomstandard.org/current target has moved.
issue_request: FHIR-30705 was a Published/Persuasive technical correction asking that the broken DICOM Tag Mapping link on the FHIR-core mappings page be updated from the obsolete NEMA DICOM page to https://www.dicomstandard.org/current.
initial_application: No local git commit explicitly mentioned FHIR-30705. Commit 0d58d10e724397da66de18b51936bc3c2702e4f7 appears to have applied the request implicitly by changing the DICOM mapping link in source/mappingSpaces.xml to https://www.dicomstandard.org/current before R5 publication.
additional_context: The mappings page is published via publish.ini and source/mappings.html, which expands the generated mappings table from mappingSpaces.xml. Later commit bc76b5717ebb4df34226f826f1a17e48093cfdd9 updated the current DICOM mapping URL to https://dicomstandard.org/current and preserved a historic http://nema.org/dicom mapping-space entry whose clickable link also points to https://www.dicomstandard.org/current. The only remaining old DICOM URI found in current source was on InventoryReport, which is not listed as an active resource in source/fhir.ini and is covered by the historic mapping-space row rather than by this mappings-page link issue.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current and historic DICOM entries in source/mappingSpaces.xml already use the requested live dicomstandard.org/current link.
